client_updates.highlight: Nethermind: quick slots and FOCIL devnet-3 changes implemented
Besu: quick slot feature not yet implemented; compliant only if slot time stays at 12s
Lodestar: FOCIL devnet-3 changes in trunk branch, merging into unstable
Prysm: FOCIL work landing in trunk, involved in devnet-2 and devnet-3

spec_updates.highlight: PR #5741 preferred over #5740: proposer considers only timely ILs when selecting bids, aligning with attester view and closing late-IL griefing attack
Second attack vector: builder broadcasts high early bid before IL deadline to crowd out compliant bids; fix is P2P gossip rule ignoring bids before IL deadline
PR #5769: Lodestar picks IL-unsatisfied payload as head; spec bug allows non-compliant payload to become head in current and next slot; fix under discussion

New FOCIL-frame engine API approach (Jihoon PRs #5772, execution-apis #960): CL passes raw ILs to EL instead of deduped IL transactions; EL handles deduplication and omission claims; max bandwidth overhead ~4.4% at 20M gas limit

testing_progress.highlight: FOCIL-frame interaction design must be settled before targeting FOCIL devnet-0; timeline not yet set, likely after DEF CON

organizational.highlight: Next FOCIL breakout pushed two weeks to November 10 due to DEF CON travel

action_items.action: Review PR #5769 (IL-unsatisfied payload as head bug) and suggest fixes
Review and provide feedback on FOCIL-frame engine API PRs (consensus-specs #5772, execution-apis #960) ahead of L1 days discussion

decisions.decision: Tentative preference for PR #5741 (only-timely IL bid selection) over #5740; final decision deferred pending bitlist-in-fork-choice discussion
Next FOCIL breakout rescheduled to November 10, 2026

targets.target: FOCIL devnet-0 (with FOCIL-frame interaction) — after DEF CON; timeline TBD
